gates.description: Release readiness criteria must be documented
No open P0 or Blocker bugs at release sign-off
Regression suite status must be documented
Test plan must indicate risk-based prioritization
Quality metrics must be reported (defect density, escape rate)

anti_patterns.description: Testing happens only after development is done — bugs found late are expensive
Running regression tests manually every release instead of automating
Measuring QA quality by bug count instead of escape rate
QA team works separately from development in a throw-over-the-wall model
Accepting flaky tests as normal rather than treating them as bugs

escalation_triggers: Release criteria not met and stakeholders are pushing to ship anyway
QA team is consistently under-resourced relative to development throughput
A recurring quality issue points to a process problem requiring organizational change
Test environment is unreliable for more than 1 week affecting QA productivity
Team members are pressured to skip testing to meet deadlines

input_requirements.description: QA.md test plan produced by QA engineer

output_certifications: No open P0 or P1 bugs
Quality metrics reported for the sprint/release
